svg.title: From Renewal Signal to Retained Contribution
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-authorized-renewal-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: From Renewal Signal to Retained Contribution; subtitle: Five operating steps separate customer subscription spend from earned brokerage revenue.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The operator has customer permission and current vendor agreements. Microsoft CPOR attribution is not interchangeable with CSP resale authority; Adobe VIP Marketplace and Zoom partner routes have their own eligibility and transfer requirements.; caption: Track one opportunity identifier across discovery, authorization, quote, activation, and settlement. No stage authorizes cross-customer seat pooling or converts client subscription spend into operator revenue.; stages: label: Detect a renewal trigger; value: Permissioned account research; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use public DNS, MX, and SPF signals to prioritize research; confirm actual products, seat counts, and renewal dates from customer-provided contracts rather than inferring license eligibility.; label: Verify the authorized route; value: Customer mandate and vendor eligibility; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Record customer authority and the applicable Microsoft CSP, CPOR, Adobe VIP Marketplace, Zoom Up, or master-agent agreement. Check transfer windows, tenant boundaries, and existing commitments.; label: Price the retained economics; value: Comparable scope and measurable savings; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Normalize term, seats, taxes, support, and service levels. Separate vendor-funded spreads from member rebates and 25%–35% shared-savings fees; disclose any combined compensation.; label: Activate and reconcile billing; value: Authorized changes with funded exposure; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Complete vendor-approved changes and reconcile Pax8, Ingram, or Telarus records where supported. Fund annual NCE exposure before commitment; monthly auto-debit alone does not cover it.; label: Recognize and monitor earnings; value: Earned consideration with clawback tracking; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Reconcile partner statements, customer acceptance, rebate conditions, and residual receipts. Apply ASC 606 contract analysis and maintain separate ledgers for client pass-through amounts, operator earnings, and potential reversals.

circle.title: label: Detect a renewal trigger; value: Permissioned account research; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use public DNS, MX, and SPF signals to prioritize research; confirm actual products, seat counts, and renewal dates from customer-provided contracts rather than inferring license eligibility.

circle.title: label: Verify the authorized route; value: Customer mandate and vendor eligibility; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Record customer authority and the applicable Microsoft CSP, CPOR, Adobe VIP Marketplace, Zoom Up, or master-agent agreement. Check transfer windows, tenant boundaries, and existing commitments.

text.title: Record customer authority and the applicable Microsoft CSP, CPOR, Adobe VIP Marketplace, Zoom Up, or master-agent agreement. Check transfer windows, tenant boundaries, and existing commitments.

circle.title: label: Price the retained economics; value: Comparable scope and measurable savings; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Normalize term, seats, taxes, support, and service levels. Separate vendor-funded spreads from member rebates and 25%–35% shared-savings fees; disclose any combined compensation.

text.title: Normalize term, seats, taxes, support, and service levels. Separate vendor-funded spreads from member rebates and 25%–35% shared-savings fees; disclose any combined compensation.

circle.title: label: Activate and reconcile billing; value: Authorized changes with funded exposure; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Complete vendor-approved changes and reconcile Pax8, Ingram, or Telarus records where supported. Fund annual NCE exposure before commitment; monthly auto-debit alone does not cover it.

text.title: Complete vendor-approved changes and reconcile Pax8, Ingram, or Telarus records where supported. Fund annual NCE exposure before commitment; monthly auto-debit alone does not cover it.

circle.title: label: Recognize and monitor earnings; value: Earned consideration with clawback tracking; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Reconcile partner statements, customer acceptance, rebate conditions, and residual receipts. Apply ASC 606 contract analysis and maintain separate ledgers for client pass-through amounts, operator earnings, and potential reversals.

text.title: Reconcile partner statements, customer acceptance, rebate conditions, and residual receipts. Apply ASC 606 contract analysis and maintain separate ledgers for client pass-through amounts, operator earnings, and potential reversals.

Assumptions: The operator has customer permission and current vendor agreements. Microsoft CPOR attribution is not interchangeable with CSP resale authority; Adobe VIP Marketplace and Zoom partner routes have their own eligibility and transfer requirements.
